title: Jacques Vallée's photo of a UFO over a lake, with every cow looking at it
summary: Joe McMoneagle tells of Jacques Vallée's photo of a UFO over a lake, with every cow looking at it, about unspecified at unspecified lake, and relays what a named person told them. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: the cows every cow in that picture was looking at the UFO

plain: Joe McMoneagle, a man known for work on psychic spying, recalls on Jesse Michels' podcast a photo he says Jacques Vallée, a longtime UFO researcher, showed him or told him about. According to McMoneagle, it showed a UFO over a lake, and every cow in the picture was looking at it. The detail matters to him because animals do not fake attention, which would suggest something real was there.
